base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent PNG mascot for a sports trading-card collector app's Burn Count. Create one original charming little anthropomorphic flame creature, plush-quality premium 3D toy illustration, amber-orange flame head, large expressive dark eyes and small rounded body, wearing a forest-green American-football jersey with one small gold lightning-bolt emblem, cream sneakers. Holds one small blank trading card in a clear protective slab. Neutral curious expression with a gently raised eyebrow, friendly and a little cheeky. Full body, centered, three-quarter front view, consistent soft studio lighting, no ground/background, genuinely transparent alpha, generous clear margin around complete silhouette. Bold readable expression at 120 pixels. Refined tactile material, appealing sports collectible vinyl-toy personality. No text, no numbers, no logos, no extra characters, no UI, no background, no shadow rectangle.
